inv.desc_es:
Retail vende excelente local comercial en rentabilidad al 5% anual triple neto situado en Alonso Cano esquina calle García de Paredes, en el madrileño distrito de Chamberí, alquilado a exitoso operador. Su ubicación privilegiada ofrece gran visibilidad y un alto tránsito peatonal y vehicular, dentro de un entorno consolidado rodeado de oficinas, centros educativos, viviendas y una amplia oferta comercial. La zona cuenta con todos los servicios y está excelentemente comunicada mediante transporte público, con varias líneas de autobús y metro a escasos minutos. Ideal para negocios de restauración que busquen una afluencia constante y un ambiente urbano, activo y dinámico.

Características:

- Superficie: 169 m² totales distribuidos en 77m² en planta calle y 92m².

- Fachada de 12 metros en esquina-chaflán.

- Altura: 3 metros.

- Salida de humos: No.

- Local diáfano.

- Muy bien comunicado en metro, bus y cercanías.

- Key Planning: MERCADO DE CHAMBERÍ, CAIXA BANK, ESTUDIO ZENTRO, SALA DE ARTE COLECCIÓN CANO, MADREAMIGA, BOTANICAL&SILVER, BAR EL TOBOSO, NISUBO - NIBAJO, RESTAURANTE BARRERA, ENERGY CAPITAL, LA COSTURERA, DOUGLAS COMPANY, MARCELO SILES MURILLO, DON LECHAL CARNICERÍA, ALIMENTACION MEDIA VILLA, ETC.

inv.desc_en:
Retail sells an excellent commercial space with a 5% annual triple net yield, located at the corner of Alonso Cano and García de Paredes streets, in Madrid's Chamberí district, leased to a successful operator. Its prime location offers great visibility and high pedestrian and vehicular traffic, within a consolidated environment surrounded by offices, educational centers, residences, and a wide range of commercial offerings. The area has all services and is excellently connected by public transport, with several bus and metro lines just a few minutes away. Ideal for restaurant businesses looking for constant foot traffic and an urban, active, and dynamic environment.

Features:

- Surface area: 169 m² total, distributed as 77 m² on the ground floor and 92 m² in the basement.
- 12-meter corner facade.
- Height: 3 meters.
- Smoke vent: No.
- Open-plan space.
- Very well connected by metro, bus, and commuter rail.
- Key Planning: MERCADO DE CHAMBERÍ, CAIXA BANK, ESTUDIO ZENTRO, SALA DE ARTE COLECCIÓN CANO, MADREAMIGA, BOTANICAL&SILVER, BAR EL TOBOSO, NISUBO - NIBAJO, RESTAURANTE BARRERA, ENERGY CAPITAL, LA COSTURERA, DOUGLAS COMPANY, MARCELO SILES MURILLO, DON LECHAL CARNICERÍA, ALIMENTACION MEDIA VILLA, ETC.

Call us to arrange a visit.

Retail is a leading specialist in commercial premises, business expansion, and investment, with more than 2,350 successful operations carried out over our more than 22 years of experience in the real estate market.

We have more premises available on the most commercial streets throughout Madrid.
